$comment: THE single source of the wicked design tokens. scripts/build.mjs generates dist/tokens.css (light and dark) and dist/tokens.json from it; never edit dist/ by hand. `from` says where each value came from: council = the operator's pick, the synthesis of the design council (design/DES-THEMES.md revision 3, option 3, 2026-10-31); brand = a name the brand SVGs reference (the brand mark keeps its own colours); studio = wicked-studio's tokens at 23866dc, where the synthesis is silent; web = wicked-web src/styles/tokens.css; guide / derived = earlier sources still used by a few tokens, the reason in `note`.
name: wicked-design

groups.surface: Page, rail, card, raised and overlay grounds, from deepest to highest.
groups.ink: Text colours, from quietest to strongest.
groups.border: Hairlines and the edge of an input field.
groups.accent: The action colour, its states and the text on it.
groups.brand: The names the brand lockup and icons reference.
groups.status: Waiting on you (gate), failed, running, warning, ok, done.
groups.plane: The four platform planes of the family sites.
groups.elevation: Shadows, the focus ring and the modal scrim.
groups.type: Families, sizes, weights and line heights.
groups.control: Control heights and the touch-target floor.
